subject.title: Feature: Add maxSubagentResultChars to truncate subagent results injected into parent session

question: Should OpenClaw add a public configurable subagent completion cap, reuse an existing agent context-limit surface, or enforce a fixed internal cap for task-completion handoffs?
rationale: The missing cap is source-proven, but the requested key/default changes public configuration semantics and affects parent-agent review quality across core subagents and harness-backed completions.

options.title: Bound handoffs without a new session key
options.body: Add a cap at the task-completion handoff and, if configurable, place it under the existing agent context-limits model rather than a new `session.*` key.

options.title: Add the requested session key
options.body: Expose `session.maxSubagentResultChars` as proposed, accepting a new config surface and matching schema/docs/doctor expectations.

options.title: Keep full child results
options.body: Leave the current behavior unchanged and rely on prompt instructions or future metadata-only completion design instead of truncation.

recommendation.title: Bound handoffs without a new session key
recommendation.body: Add a cap at the task-completion handoff and, if configurable, place it under the existing agent context-limits model rather than a new `session.*` key.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant history is the structured internal completion event and recent subagent handoff work on the central files.
